title: Egyptian Orange Tagine
description: A traditional North African dish made with chicken, oranges, and spices. This recipe is perfect for a cold winter night.

ingredients.name: Egyptian spices
ingredients.notes: A blend of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

ingredients.name: Tagine spice
ingredients.notes: A blend of cinnamon, ginger, and cardamom

instructions: Season the chicken thighs with salt and black pepper.
Heat the oil in a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the Egyptian spices and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken thighs and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the orange juice, zesty olives, and tagine spice.
Cover the tagine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with chopped parsley and orange slices.
Serve hot over couscous or rice.
